result.effect: -12 PISA points; -14.2% SD; roughly 7 months of learning

cells.quote: The overall decline in mathematics associated with pandemic-era school closures is 12 points. In 2022, the average within-country SD of mathematics is 86.2. Thus, the decline in achievement is equal to 14.2% of a SD. Considering that one year of learning is equivalent to roughly 20 points on the PISA scale26, this means that on average across around 70 countries students lost an equivalent of more than 7 months of learning.
cells.note: The comparison is the estimated country-specific linear trend, not a randomized control group.
